title: EDD-001 sandbox evidence event v1
description: Agent L ownership. An EvidenceEvent is serialized with canonical JSON (sorted keys, tight separators, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) and content-addressed as sha256(canonical bytes) under receipt_root/<run_id>/<event_hash>.json. verification and promotion events must carry candidate_sha256 in input_hashes. Recording is append-only and idempotent: an existing event_hash path with identical bytes yields the same valid receipt; different bytes yield valid=false and the existing file is preserved.
